'''''Mace Windu: The Glass Abyss''''', originally announced as simply '''''The Glass Abyss''''', is an adult novel written by [[Steven Barnes]]. The book takes place shortly after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and was published by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[October 15]], [[2024]].
